title: silicone egg/cup cooker set
text: silicone egg/cup cooker set. I purchased this silicone cooker set because it also offered a rack for easy in and out of your pressure cooker or pot AND lids for the silicone cups.  The cups themselves are firmer than the lids - which makes them easier to place no matter how you are using - that's a real bonus in my opinion. They say top rack dishwasher, but I hand washed for the first use.  It comes with a bunch of stuff I don't need... the plastic measuring spoons... silicone baby spoon... I am going to keep the ice pop lids and sticks because my grandsons love those.  The cups are about 1 egg size.  I am going to see about making eggs and deviling them - cool shape.  We'll see!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Egg Bites Mold for Instant Pot 6 qt Accessories, 2 Pack Silicone Egg Bite Molds Fit 5,6,8 qt Pressure Cooker, Sous Vide Egg Poacher Reusable Baby Food Container Freezer Tray with Lid, Steamer Rack
features: [SAFE AND DURABLE MATERIAL] Egg bites molds are made from 100% food grade silicone that is LFGB approved. Pinch test pass is guaranteed which means there is no plastic filler. The egg bites molds are free of BPA, lead, phthalate or toxic chemicals. All pieces of silicone egg mold are odor resistant. No bad smell comes out after cooking, no soapy taste remains after washing. Consevisen egg bites molds are thicker and stand up during filling. Edges will not bend or flop around.

[NON-STICK AND EASY TO CLEAN] The egg bites molds provide non-sticking feature in cooking and washing. You can easily pop the delicious egg bites out of the silicone molds in a good shape. The silicone egg bites molds are dishwasher safe. More than that, you can wash them by hand with two bonus small sized brushes. Wash egg bites molds for instant pot under running tap water with little dish soap, just few steps are required. Cleanup is a breeze.

[EXCELLENT VERSATILITY, FUNCTIONAL LIDS] The egg bite molds with lids resist temperatures from-40°F to 446°F and can be directly used in 5, 6, 8 quart instant pot and electric pressure cooker, microwave, oven, stockpot and freezer. 2 clip-on silicone lids are good for sealing the molds to keep condensation and moisture off the egg bites. Seal lid makes it easy to put leftovers in fridge and keep the freshness of food. They keep the inner of egg bite tray away from the dust while not in use.

[MULTIUSAGE, EASY TO USE] The egg bites molds are perfect in making delicious egg bites, mini cupcakes, muffin bites, hard boiled eggs without shells, poached egg, baby food, ice balls, ice cream and other bite sized snacks. The silicone egg bites molds can also be used as sous vide egg poacher, baby food freezer tray, food storage containers under normal temperature and in freezer. Working with silicone egg bites mold helps to make quick and healthy breakfast. Save time and money!

[SMART SET] The box contains 2 different colored egg bites molds with lids, stackable to be used at the same time. Adding 1 stainless steel rack trivet with heat resistant handles for easily getting the molds in or out of pot without burning yourself, 5 measuring spoons, 7 popsicle sticks, 2 small sized brushes, 1 basting brush, instruction paper and recipes.
